subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: Should this broad field report remain an umbrella after its dashboard-auth and incomplete-turn portions are routed to narrower work, or should maintainers split the remaining installer/auth, runtime-compatibility, and context-policy claims into separately owned reports?
rationale: The requested outcome spans multiple compatibility-sensitive owners and includes product-policy choices such as automatic context compaction, fallback summaries, and visible lifecycle state; source-level facts alone cannot choose the intended scope.

options.title: Split into narrow canonical reports
options.body: Recommended: preserve the reporter's evidence, link the dashboard-auth portion to the open canonical issue, and request current-release reproductions before creating separate owner-scoped work.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Retain this issue as a coordination record only if maintainers explicitly want one reliability program with named owners and acceptance boundaries.

recommendation.title: Split into narrow canonical reports
recommendation.body: Recommended: preserve the reporter's evidence, link the dashboard-auth portion to the open canonical issue, and request current-release reproductions before creating separate owner-scoped work.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged related recovery work makes this person the only evidence-backed routing candidate available, though the broader ownership is shared and needs maintainer assignment.
